basics.name: Emerson Quijada Rafael
basics.label: Computer Science Graduate | Full Stack Developer (Java/Angular)
basics.summary: Full Stack Developer focused on building scalable software and maintainable architectures that solve real business problems. Solid experience designing APIs and complete systems with Java, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL, deployed with Docker and orchestrated alongside modern interfaces in Angular and Astro. I specialize in delivering high technical value through clean code, design patterns, and offline-first solutions to ensure an excellent user experience.

work.name: Importaciones DENRAF
work.summary: Business management system for import and retail businesses in fairs. Complete Full Stack architecture with Angular 19 on the frontend and Spring Boot 3.5 / Java 21 on the backend, deployed in production with Docker on Digital Ocean.
highlights: Developed the core POS and Sales modules, handling fluid daily transactional processing using secure concurrency with @Version in Spring Data.
Created an Urgent Liquidation algorithm using the Strategy Pattern that optimized revenue and inventory turnover during key real-world fair days (Thursday/Sunday).
Implemented an offline-first architecture with IndexedDB and Service Workers, ensuring zero business interruptions in areas with low or no connectivity.
Designed a robust REST API using Hexagonal Architecture and DDD, secured with JWT and validated by unit tests (JUnit/Mockito), centralizing business logic for 7 modules.
Optimized frontend performance using Angular Signals and Lazy Loading, and deployed the complete ecosystem using Docker Compose on a Digital Ocean Droplet.

work.name: Calzados La Peruanita
work.summary: Led the end-to-end design and implementation of a cloud-based sales and inventory system using Angular, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL, allowing the store to integrate its invoicing and logistics.
highlights: Architected the relational data model in PostgreSQL to support complex, hierarchical inventory management (product → color → size).
Developed secure RESTful APIs with Spring Boot to orchestrate invoicing, order management, and operational reporting for the business.
Built a reactive and modular UI in Angular, optimizing the administrator's workflows for stock and sales control.
Automated the deployment of the Full Stack ecosystem across multiple cloud environments (Render for the backend and Vercel for the frontend).
